## Parental OpControl 0.17.7

- Luna's chat window now opens at **50% of the working-area width and 80% of its height** (minimum 520 × 600 where the screen allows it, maximum 60% × 90%), so the right edge reaches about the middle of the screen. The resize grip still works and the child's last size is remembered per device.
- Luna and child bubbles can use up to **88% of the chat column**, so more text fits per line. Pictures and display math stay centred and keep their size limits.
- Fixed the chat jumping back to the top after a reply. Sending scrolls to the bottom; a short reply stays at the bottom; a reply taller than the view keeps its first line in view; and if the child has scrolled up, a small **New message ↓** pill appears instead of moving the chat.
- The child's bubbles use the design's dark text on every subject colour in Night sky, and all six subject colours pass 4.5:1 contrast in both themes.
- This release is installed on the X1 only; the Yoga is not updated. Luna stays enabled with the same key.
